Pavel Dvorak  
Staff Backend Engineer | E-Commerce Innovations Ltd.  
Email: pavel.dvorak@email.com | Phone: (123) 456-7890 | Location: San Francisco, CA | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/pdvorak  

A seasoned backend engineer with 11 years of experience shaping scalable e-commerce systems. My work spans architecture design, team leadership, and operational excellence, with a focus on high-availability systems, CI/CD automation, and performance optimization. Specialized in Go, microservices, and distributed systems, with a track record of reducing infrastructure costs and improving system resilience through chaos engineering.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Staff Backend Engineer*  
E-Commerce Innovations Ltd. (2018–Present)  
- Spearheaded the migration of monolithic services to microservices, reducing infrastructure costs by 30% and improving deployment velocity by 50% through Kubernetes orchestration and AWS Lambda integration.  
- Redesigned global inventory synchronization pipelines using Redis and PostgreSQL, achieving 99.99% data consistency across 15 regional clusters.  
- Led the implementation of chaos engineering practices, reducing unplanned downtime by 70% and improving incident resolution times by 40% via automated fault injection and Prometheus-based monitoring.  
- Architected a serverless-based order processing system, eliminating 200+ manual maintenance tasks and scaling to handle 50M+ transactions/month.  

*Senior Backend Engineer*  
RetailScale Solutions (2015–2018)  
- Engineered a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions and Terraform, cutting deployment cycles from 2 hours to 15 minutes and eliminating 80% of manual configuration errors.  
- Developed a distributed logging framework using Fluentd and Elasticsearch, reducing log analysis latency by 60% and enabling real-time troubleshooting for 20+ microservices.  
- Designed a rate-limiting layer for API gateways using Redis and Go, preventing 15+ DDoS attacks and ensuring 99.95% SLA compliance during peak traffic.  

*Junior Backend Developer*  
StartupWave Technologies (2012–2015)  
- Built core components of a B2B e-commerce platform using Python and PostgreSQL, supporting 100K+ monthly active users.  
- Implemented automated testing frameworks with PyTest and Jenkins, reducing regression bugs by 45% and improving code coverage to 85%.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **AWS**: Owned the migration of 12 critical services to AWS, achieving 30% cost savings via spot instance utilization and DynamoDB optimization.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Designed and maintained GitHub Actions workflows for 15+ microservices, reducing deployment time by 70% and eliminating 90% of manual intervention.  
- **Chaos Engineering**: Led production-grade chaos experiments using Chaos Monkey, identifying 12+ critical single points of failure and improving system resilience.  
- **GitHub Actions**: Integrated with Terraform and Prometheus to automate infrastructure provisioning and monitoring, reducing on-call incidents by 55%.  
- **Linux Administration**: Managed 50+ Linux servers for a global e-commerce platform, achieving 99.9% uptime through proactive kernel tuning and resource allocation.  
- **Monitoring & Alerting**: Built Grafana dashboards with Prometheus to track 50+ metrics across 200+ services, reducing mean time to detect (MTTD) by 60%.  
- **Prometheus/Grafana**: Centralized metrics collection for 10+ microservices, enabling real-time anomaly detection and 20% improvement in incident response.  
- **Go**: Architected core components of 5+ microservices, mentoring 10+ engineers and driving 40% performance improvements through concurrency optimization.  
- **Microservices Architecture**: Designed and scaled systems with 50+ services, ensuring loose coupling and fault isolation while maintaining 99.95% SLA.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimized query performance for 10+ databases, reducing latency by 50% and scaling to handle 10M+ queries/day.  
- **REST API Design**: Built and maintained 20+ APIs with OpenAPI specs, ensuring 95%+ integration success rates across 50+ third-party systems.  
- **Redis**: Implemented distributed caching for 5+ services, reducing database load by 70% and improving read latency to under 10ms.  
- **Python**: Developed internal tools for CI/CD and data analysis, streamlining 50+ manual processes and improving team productivity by 35%.  
- **Message Queues**: Designed Kafka-based pipelines for 10+ services, achieving 99.99% message delivery reliability and reducing backlog by 80%.  

**Projects**  
- *Global Inventory Sync System*: Redesigned a distributed inventory system using Redis and PostgreSQL, reducing synchronization latency by 40% and improving data consistency across 15 regions.  
- *Chaos Engineering Framework*: Built a custom chaos engineering toolkit with Prometheus and Chaos Monkey, enabling 100+ production-grade experiments annually.  
- *Serverless Order Processing*: Architected a serverless-based order pipeline using AWS Lambda and DynamoDB, eliminating 200+ manual maintenance tasks.
